summary:
Iter 47 — Visual-regression check for the guardian-fest-final theme (dark obsidian bg #050510, gold #D4AF37/#F0D68C, purple #7C6CFF, turquoise #40E0D0, translucent surface2/3, purple SHADOW, gold GLASS.edge). Backend testing SKIPPED per request. Frontend verified end-to-end at 390x844 on preview host via founder-bypass-btn.

RESULT: NO VISUAL OR FUNCTIONAL REGRESSIONS DETECTED. Zero pageerrors, zero red screens, zero new console errors (only pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents RN-web deprecation warnings and expo-notifications-web warning — unchanged from iter 46).

SCREENS VERIFIED (all render, all text readable white/gold on obsidian, tab bar + gold accents intact):
(1) /login — background photo + gradient overlay (deep-blue→obsidian) crisp; language chips (Slovenčina, English active, Deutsch, Polski, Magyar, Русский, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, العربية…) visible; SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE white pill; founder-bypass-btn (gold key icon + 'ENTER AS GUARDIAN ANGEL (FOUNDER)') present on preview host.
(2) Home — home-welcome-banner ('Good day, Guardian.') + Guardian Angel OS card + MAGIC LENS tile (gold accent) + JARVIS orb (LVL 3, gold ring, purple shadow visible) + geo pill 'New York · US' + HEALING LOOP (40%, 5 numbered steps INTAKE/FINANCIAL SHIELD/ACCESS/PAPERWORK/RECOVERY) + DAILY BRIEFING + DEMO badge (top-right, gold pill) + tab bar HEALING / FAMILY SHIELD / VAULT all rendered.
(3) Family Shield hub — ANGEL MODE tile (gold border + gold icon), + ADD FAMILY MEMBER, HEROIC SENIOR SUITE (Magic Lens, Family Messages, Voice Signature) — all tiles readable with translucent card surfaces.
(4) Vault hub — Note: `text=VAULT` selector navigated to Family Messages sub-screen ('ODKAZY OD RODINY' — known Slovak deep-secondary title, do-not-flag per E1 note). Screen still rendered cleanly with dark theme.
(5) /health-timeline (Life Card) — LIFE CARD title, MY CARD / CHILD toggle, identity card (Guardian Angel · IDENTITY · SOURCE: BIRTH CERTIFICATE · DATE OF BIRTH 15.3.1985 · AGE 41 y. · BLOOD TYPE A+), 4 action tiles (✨ MAGIC LENS, PDF FOR DOCTOR, EU VACCINATION PASS, HEALTH TRENDS), Jarvis voice hint, PREDICTIONS · JARVIS box with CHECK-UP · 2026-09-15 (Annual physical examination — demo prediction preserved) + gold ADD TO CALENDAR button. lc-edit opens editor: name input, date-of-birth chip, blood-type chips (A+ A- B+ B- AB+ AB- 0+ 0- — translucent surface2 chips clearly readable), lc-gdpr-consent checkbox 'I consent to storing my health data' visible, lc-save-card gold button. SCAN BIRTH CERTIFICATE + FROM GALLERY translucent buttons legible. Editor closes via X.
(6) /magic-lens intro — gold OPEN CAMERA button + CHOOSE A PHOTO FROM GALLERY outlined button; hero text 'Point me at any health document.' readable.
(7) /jarvis — LVL 3 · STRÁŽCA orb (Slovak 'STRÁŽCA' is content-side i18n gap already flagged in previous iterations; theme unchanged), mode chips jv-mode-chat / jv-mode-sonar / jv-mode-imagine all present and tappable; MORNING BRIEFING card rendered with translucent card surface + play button — all readable.
(8) /profile — PROFILE header + Guardian Angel identity card (email + did:guardian:d57181378…), DEMO MODE section with DEMO BADGE toggle (prof-demo-badge, ON — gold thumb visible), LANGUAGE grid (12 chips, English active gold), SENTIENT UX (Jarvis Voice · Onyx + Bio-Timeline birth year 1985 + SAVE gold button).

CONTRAST CHECK — no dark-on-dark text observed. Secondary text at rgba(255,255,255,0.7) meets AA on #050510 (>7:1). Gold #D4AF37 on obsidian passes AA. Translucent card surface2 (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) sits on #050510 giving effective #14141C — still crisp against white body text. Chip borders visible.

MODAL/SHEET REGRESSION — lc-edit form (essentially the requested surface2/surface3 sanity check) renders correctly with the new translucent tokens; inputs, chips and gold save CTA all remain readable. Did not additionally open a native date-picker sheet as the current view already exercises the exact translucent surface tokens.

DEMO toggle in Settings — prof-demo-badge toggle exists and is currently ON (gold). Not toggled off (would remove demo badge globally); design regression only.

No dev/founder bypass session was used to hit POST /api/lifecard/predictions (would wipe demo prediction — respected).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing warnings persist: 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'textShadow*' → textShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Unchanged by theme update. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts SHADOW token still uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset — these are RN-native-only and correctly Platform-gated in glass.tsx (SHADOW applied only when Platform.OS !== 'web'), so the deprecations come from other pre-existing files, not from the theme change.
Warning 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — pre-existing, expected.

action_items: None required for this visual regression. Theme change is clean.

OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 46, not caused by this iter): /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx label 'OBRAZ' → 'IMAGE'; Jarvis LVL screen still shows Slovak 'STRÁŽCA' next to LEVEL 3 — same known Slovak deep-secondary leak.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts is well-structured: tokens grouped (color, gradients, glass, shadow, radii, spacing, fonts). SHADOW token uses shadowColor with #7C6CFF and elevation 8 — correct for native. Consumers must Platform-gate on web (glass.tsx already does: `Platform.OS !== 'web' && (SHADOW as any)`), so no new web deprecation warnings introduced.

/app/frontend/src/ui/glass.tsx GlassCard: SHADOW applied only when Platform.OS !== 'web' — good. GLASS.edge is 3-stop purple→white→gold gradient border technique using hairline padding (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth * 3) — renders correctly. BlurView disabled on Android (Platform.OS !== 'android') — correct (BlurView native perf), web still gets blur.

/app/frontend/app/login.tsx overlay LinearGradient colors deepened to ['rgba(10,10,46,0.30)', 'rgba(5,5,16,0.88)', 'rgba(5,5,16,0.98)'] — matches obsidian palette; background pexels image + gradient overlay reads correctly on mobile viewport.
R.md changed 20 → 16 — visually confirmed rounder cards still look consistent across home tiles, health-timeline identity card, blood-type chips.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested visual regression flows: login, home, family shield, /health-timeline (lc-edit + lc-gdpr-consent + lc-save-card), /magic-lens, /jarvis (3 mode chips), /profile (prof-demo-badge). 0 pageerrors, 0 red screens, 0 new console errors.

seed_data_creation: None. Founder demo Life Card + calendar timeline preserved (did not call /api/lifecard/predictions or /api/demo/reset).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme tokens live in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Palette: bg #050510, gold #D4AF37 / #F0D68C, primary purple #7C6CFF, accent turquoise #40E0D0, surface2/3 translucent rgba white. SHADOW = purple glow for native only (Platform-gated in glass.tsx). GLASS.edge = 3-stop purple→white→gold. All main + secondary screens verified visually clean at 390x844 mobile web preview. Founder bypass: click [data-testid="founder-bypass-btn"] on /login → auto-navigates to /(tabs). Screens with testIDs used this iter: founder-bypass-btn, home-welcome-banner, home-magic-lens, home-orb, demo-badge, lc-edit, lc-gdpr-consent, lc-save-card, jv-mode-chat/sonar/imagine, prof-demo-badge.
